WI-14a (UC-009 web lane) — Poptávka (Demand) tab for /x/analytics.

== WHAT WAS DELIVERED ==

1. TYPED CLIENT (client.ts additions):
   - HeatmapCellDto, SupplyDemandBucketDto, UnmetDemandBucketDto, DriverUtilizationDto, UtilizationDto, ZonePickupDto, DemandTopRouteDto, DemandPriorDto, AnalyticsDemandResponse, AnalyticsDemandParams (= AnalyticsOverviewParams)
   - getAnalyticsDemand(params) — GET /api/v1/analytics/demand?from&to&granularity&compare
   NOTE: The existing reports section had a TopRouteDto with different fields (routeId, name, count). Renamed the demand one to DemandTopRouteDto to avoid the conflict.

2. HOOK: useAnalyticsDemand.ts — query key ['analytics', 'demand', params], clones useAnalyticsOverview pattern.

3. PURE CHART CONFIG BUILDERS (demandCharts.ts):
   - buildHeatmapChartConfig(cells) — Bar chart, 7 datasets (one per DOW 0=Sun…6=Sat), x=hours 0–23
   - buildSupplyDemandChartConfig(buckets) — grouped Bar, 2 datasets (ordersCreated, onlineSeconds→hours)
   - buildUnmetDemandChartConfig(buckets) — single Bar dataset
   All builders are pure TypeScript (no React import), testable without canvas.

4. CSV BUILDERS (demandCsv.ts, via shared toCsv):
   - buildHeatmapCsv(cells) — 24 rows × 8 cols (Hodina + 7 DOW); BOM + ';' + CRLF
   - buildZonePickupsCsv(zones) — Zóna + Vyzvednutí columns
   - buildTopRoutesCsv(routes) — Odkud + Kam + Počet columns

5. COMPONENT (DemandTab.tsx):
   - Sections: heatmap (Bar + sr-only table), supply/demand (Bar + sr-only table), unmet demand (Bar + sr-only table), utilization (fleet % card + per-driver table), zone pickups (visible table), top routes (visible table)
   - 3 CSV export buttons: heatmap, zone pickups, top routes
   - Loading / error / empty states
   - Every chart has a visually-hidden <table> for screen readers
   - Axe a11y: all sections use aria-labelledby, tables have caption+scope, buttons have accessible text

6. WIRING: AnalyticsPage.tsx now renders <DemandTab params={overviewParams} /> for activeTab === 'poptavka'. AnalyticsPage.test.tsx updated to mock getAnalyticsDemand and assert DemandTab loads.

7. I18N: analytics.demand.* keys added to both cs.json and en.json (parity test passes).

== DEVIATIONS FROM WI ==
- DemandTopRouteDto instead of TopRouteDto: The reports section already exports TopRouteDto with different fields (routeId, name, count). Renamed to DemandTopRouteDto to prevent the duplicate-interface TS error. Semantically correct — the analytics demand endpoint uses pickup/dropoff addresses, not route IDs.
- AnalyticsPage.test.tsx updated: The existing test 'shows a placeholder when clicking Poptávka' was changed to 'shows the Demand tab when clicking Poptávka' (loading state), plus a new test 'shows a placeholder when clicking other non-implemented tabs' for Provoz etc.

== TRAPS ==
- TopRouteDto name collision: reports section already has TopRouteDto with routeId/name/count. Any future demand work must use DemandTopRouteDto.
- DOW=0 is Sunday (Postgres convention). Czech display order is Mon-first but heatmap datasets are indexed 0–6 matching the backend. Labels: ['Ne','Po','Út','St','Čt','Pá','So'].
- Bar mock only: chartMockModule exports Line/Bar/Doughnut stubs. DemandTab uses only Bar — no combo/Chart needed.
